voice_identity.description: energetic, mature male hardware presenter with clear diction and natural breath

zh: 今天这场 AI 合成概念演示，我们直接拆解旗舰显卡装机最关键的四件事：供电、散热、线材和空间。
先看供电！别只盯一个功耗数字，整机负载、瞬时余量和官方建议，必须一起核算。
接着看散热路径：冷空气从哪里进，热量从哪里走，显卡和机箱风道要形成完整回路。
这是一段新架构散热思路的概念演示，不代表正式规格；真正装机前，请核对官方资料。
接口一定要插到底，线材不要硬折，还要给接头留下稳定、自然的弯折空间。
机箱风道不是风扇越多越好，方向、阻力和排热路径配对，整机才会稳定。
再检查长度、厚度、侧板距离和线材转弯半径，任何一项太紧，后面都会变成隐患。
最后记住：供电、散热、线材、空间，四项一起过清单，再决定你的整机方案。
en: Welcome to this AI-generated concept demo. Today we are breaking down the four checks that matter most: power, cooling, cables, and clearance.
Start with power. Do not chase one headline number—check total system load, transient headroom, and the official recommendation together.
Now follow the airflow. Cool air in, heat out, and a clear path through the GPU and the chassis—that is the system you want.
This is a concept demonstration of next-generation cooling ideas, not an official specification. Verify every real build with official documentation.
Seat the connector completely, avoid sharp cable bends, and leave enough natural clearance around the plug.
More fans do not automatically mean better cooling. Direction, resistance, and exhaust have to work as one balanced path.
Measure card length, thickness, side-panel clearance, and cable bend radius before you commit to the case.
Here is the final checklist: power, cooling, cables, and space. Validate all four, then lock in the build.
